name: Khus Khus Halwa
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 medium-sized mango, peeled and fleshed removed

steps: Blend together the mango flesh, sugar, milk, vanilla, and cinnamon powder until smooth.
Add a bit of maida to the batter and whisk it well.
Dip the bread slices in the batter and fry them in a oiled pan until brown on both sides.
